description_full: JAPAN POST BANK Co., Ltd. provides financial products and services in Japan and internationally. The company offers regular, fixed, and wealth building saving accounts, remittance and payment pension account. It also provides loans and lending comprising mortgage, account overdraft, and savings-secured automatic loans. In addition, it offers asset management and defined contribution pension plans, including investment trusts, variable annuities, and government bonds. Further, it provides stores and ATM services. The company was formerly known as Yucho Co, Ltd. and changed its name to JAPAN POST BANK Co., Ltd. in October 2007. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. JAPAN POST BANK Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Japan Post Holdings Co., Ltd.

financial_summary: JAPAN POST BANK CO LTD is a large-cap financial services business with a $73.3B market cap on $11.6B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +1% over the past three years, which puts it in mature, slow-growth territory.
The company is burning through $59.8B of cash, and without positive owner earnings any valuation rests on hope rather than evidence.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year.

Shareholder yield of 2.4% reflects a genuine commitment to returning capital rather than empire-building, and insiders hold 50% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is.
